body.title: git_patch: patches, archives and bundles
body.summary: Add git_patch with apply, am, format-patch, archive, bundle, fast-export, diagnose and bugreport. An op that writes a named file (archive --output, format-patch --output-directory, bundle create, diagnose and bugreport output, fast-export to a file) is destructive; the same op without a file is common or none. Mark the rows covered with cases; only this Task's own rows are checked.
acceptanceChecks: Each op has a coverage case that checks the patch, archive or bundle it produces or applies
An op writing over a named file is destructive and the same op without one is not, both tested
Denied with no client before git starts leaves the repository and the file unchanged

tests.name: src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-coverage.test.ts: git_patch covered rows produce or apply the patch, archive or bundle
src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-patch.test.ts: an op writing a named file is destructive, the same op without one is not, and a denial leaves the file unchanged
